items.context: Dating and social startup; maintained two product lines (Sugarbee and Bound), responsible for app development, the NestJS backend, and paid AI features
jobDesc: Added subscription auto-renewal and failed-payment retries, lifting monthly revenue from NT$210K to NT$380K (+81%).
Shipped four paid AI features — match suggestions, chat coaching, icebreakers, bio generation — with a two-tier fallback keeping service up during model failures.
Rewrote queries with virtual generated columns and composite indexes: 5s → milliseconds, APIs averaging 180ms; first contentful paint 10s → 1.4s.
Routed moderation by media type and cached generated results, cutting monthly cloud spend from US$1,200 to US$400 (−60%).
Built an AI support agent on a Python RAG stack over the FAQ and knowledge base, escalating to a human when confidence drops below threshold.
Delivered the Flutter app, NestJS backend, and Docker deployment single-handedly, with content moderation and real-person face verification.

items.context: Game and live-streaming platform; led 11 engineers and owned architecture and technical decisions across 12 product lines
jobDesc: Took a proof-of-concept mini-game to production and grew it into a 12-title product line, leading 11 engineers.
Designed the microservice architecture for high-concurrency draw and peak traffic: Kafka for cross-service event streams, Redis and Bull Queue for caching and async settlement.
Established a release checklist and standardized release process, reducing release defects by 70%.
Built monitoring and logging on Sentry, Kibana, and Grafana and documented standard troubleshooting steps, improving problem isolation by 50%.
Introduced design review and code review, later adopted as the shared standard across product lines.

items.context: Game and lottery platform; responsible for backend development, system analysis, and restructuring inherited systems
jobDesc: Refactored an unmaintained inherited system into layered modules, so new game types build on the existing architecture without touching core logic.
Lead backend on the blockchain fair-random-number platform: combined multiple data sources into verifiable random numbers and wrote the EOS smart contracts for on-chain proof.
Sole owner of lottery game types, the crawler data pipeline, and the operations dashboard — schema design through production operations.
Performed index and query optimization on reporting and settlement bottlenecks to improve response time.

items.context: Software consultancy; delivered 7 client engagements spanning requirements analysis through production operations
jobDesc: Delivered lending, video streaming, equipment repair, and e-commerce projects from zero to one — requirements analysis through production operations.
Built the video streaming platform on AWS with Lambda + FFmpeg for transcoding and image blurring, replacing manual releases with automated deployment.
Selected technology stacks by project requirement, including C#, Node.js, React, and Salesforce (Apex, VisualForce).
Split frontend/backend responsibilities and redesigned APIs to cut module coupling, adding unit and functional testing.
Applied Clean Code and design patterns, unifying naming, layering, and responsibility boundaries.
First point of contact for new hires, maintaining environment setup and project docs to shorten onboarding.
